name: CLI-Anything
description: "CLI-Anything: Making ALL Software Agent-Native" -- CLI-Hub: https://clianything.cc/
one_liner: A toolkit for generating command-line tools so AI agents can control any piece of software the same way a human would, with a public hub of pre-built CLIs for apps like Calibre and Rekordbox.
buyer: A developer building an AI-agent product who needs their agent to control third-party apps, like photo libraries or DJ software, that have no API.
business_use_cases: An agent-platform startup uses the CLI-Hub registry to instantly give their agents control over dozens of desktop apps instead of writing custom integrations for each.
A systems integrator builds a paid custom CLI for a client's legacy in-house software so the client's AI agents can finally automate it.
A productivity SaaS offers 'AI automation' for apps it doesn't own by wrapping them with a CLI-Anything-generated interface.

money_ideas.idea: Offer paid custom-CLI development for companies whose internal software has no automation path today.
Host a premium, vetted tier of the CLI-Hub with support contracts for enterprises.

steal_this: Pick one popular app with no API that people complain about automating, build its CLI with this framework, and list it on CLI-Hub to get early users.
